I will reveal to you, based on the fact that I could rely on you, the height of the crisis that led to Laurent Kamila assassination, he personally mandated and instructed my husband to create and fully equip special elite force, to protect him against the rebels then, working against his government. This money was transported through diplomatic means, and negotiation was still in progress when the news came to me that our President has been shot. He then quickly decided to stop all negotiations and diverted the all funds to our personal use, as it was golden opportunity. He then left the children and me and went back home to attend the funeral of Laurent Kamila where he was also killed. This money is presently deposited in a Security Company here in Johannesburg, South Africa since January 2001 although the Security Company does not know the real content of the box. I have made all the necessary arrangement on our own side to ensure smooth remittance. I intend to keep my presence here in South Africa low profile due to my popularity back home, so I request all information provided to be kept secret and confidential.
